funding.description:
This project doesn't have any sponsor, sugardaddy, sugarmommy, crypto-whale investor, bored millionaire, or mysterious trench-coat philanthropist. It runs purely on volunteer work, server bills, and a steady stream of kebab + coffee expenses — all of which only dig the financial hole deeper. Still, this app remains a love project.



If you want to support our cause and help make this website even worse, any amount is HIGHLY appreciated. If you don't have money to spare — honestly, who does in this economy? — you can still help by sharing this app and spreading the annoyance further.
funding.disclaimerDetails:
This project is developed by a private individual based in Hungary. Any financial support or donation— including crypto—is voluntary, final, and does not grant you any rights, services, or special access. Donations are not tax-deductible.



No legal, tax, or financial advice is provided. If you have questions about donating or your own tax obligations, please consult a qualified professional in your jurisdiction.



All funds received are handled in accordance with applicable Hungarian tax laws.
funding.moneyUsageDescription: Your support helps compensate the time and effort I put into development, and it also contributes to covering infrastructure and tool costs (such as hosting, services, and development tools). Donations simply help keep the project alive and sustainable. Let's put money into the jar!
funding.topSupportersDescription: Once this project actually starts getting donations, real people will appear here. So if you wish to be part of this list please contact me so that I can either manually upgrade this page or figure out some mechanism to do so.
